Summary: To browse products by category and sub-category
Description: As a customer, I want to browse products by category and sub-category, so that I can find what I need without typing.

Summary: To search products by name and get results even with small spelling mistakes
Description: As a customer, I want to search products by name and get results even with small spelling mistakes, so that I find items quickly.

Summary: To filter results by price, brand and veg / non-veg
Description: As a customer, I want to filter results by price, brand and veg / non-veg, so that I narrow a long list to what suits me.

Summary: To see whether an item is in stock at my nearest store
Description: As a customer, I want to see whether an item is in stock at my nearest store, so that I don't order something that cannot be delivered.

Summary: To add items to my cart and change quantities
Description:
As a customer, I want to add items to my cart and change quantities, so that I can build my order.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I am on the product page of 'Basmati Rice 5kg' which is in stock When I tap 'Add to cart' Then the cart badge shows 1 and the cart total increases by Rs.645
- Given my cart has 1 'Basmati Rice 5kg' When I change the quantity to 3 Then the line total becomes Rs.1,935 and the cart total is updated

Summary: To apply a coupon code to my cart
Description:
As a customer, I want to apply a coupon code to my cart, so that I get the advertised discount.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given my cart total is Rs.1,200 and coupon FRESH100 needs a minimum of Rs.999 When I apply FRESH100 Then Rs.100 is deducted and the coupon is shown on the bill
- Given coupon DIWALI50 expired on 31 Oct 2026 When I apply DIWALI50 Then I see 'This coupon has expired' and the cart total does not change

As a customer, I want to choose a 2-hour delivery slot, so that someone is home when the order arrives.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given slots for today 6–8 PM have capacity When I choose 6–8 PM Then the slot is reserved for 10 minutes while I pay
- Given the 6–8 PM slot has no capacity left When I open the slot list Then 6–8 PM is greyed out with 'Full' and cannot be selected

Summary: To pay by UPI, card or cash on delivery
Description:
As a customer, I want to pay by UPI, card or cash on delivery, so that I can pay the way I prefer.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I have chosen UPI and my UPI app approves the payment When the payment gateway confirms success Then the order is placed and I see the order number
- Given my UPI payment is declined When the gateway returns a failure Then the order is not placed, the cart is kept and I can retry or choose another method

Summary: To reorder a previous order in one tap
Description: As a returning customer, I want to reorder a previous order in one tap, so that my weekly shopping takes a minute.

Summary: To see my order status (packed, out for delivery, delivered)
Description:
As a customer, I want to see my order status (packed, out for delivery, delivered), so that I know when to expect it.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given my order is packed at the store When the delivery partner picks it up Then my order status changes to 'Out for delivery' within 1 minute

Summary: To get a notification when my order is out for delivery
Description: As a customer, I want to get a notification when my order is out for delivery, so that I can be ready at the door.

Summary: To report a missing or damaged item after delivery
Description: As a customer, I want to report a missing or damaged item after delivery, so that I get a refund without calling the store.

Summary: To track the delivery partner live on a map
Description: As a customer, I want to track the delivery partner live on a map, so that I know exactly how far away they are.
